summary: Frontend-only verification of two NEW additions: Global-Flag deep-dive lesson (index 12) and Golf Leaderboard capstone (index 16). All tests pass. App loads showing Regex course with 18 lessons and no console errors. Global-flag lesson runs all 5 demo snippets successfully with the exact expected outputs. Both global-flag exercises pass with the required solutions. Golf leaderboard renders with 4 rows (double/novowel/hashtag/three), initial state shows '—' for all bests and '0/4 holes solved'. Solving Regex Golf HOLE 1 with #"(.)\1" (5 chars) records best=5 in localStorage under key regex_golf_scores_v1 and the leaderboard updates to show best-double=5 and solved=1/4. Reset button clears both localStorage and the leaderboard cells back to '—' and 0/4. Regression: Lesson 1 re-seq digits snippet still returns ("66" "99"). No console errors or page errors observed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (global-flag lesson index 12 and golf-leaderboard capstone index 16) work correctly. When testing CodeMirror-based Exercise inputs, prefer clicking data-testid='exercise-solution-{idx}' (which invokes showSolution to fill the correct answer into React state) rather than trying to type into .cm-content — direct keyboard typing via Ctrl+A + type is unreliable against CodeMirror 6 in this app and produced empty/appended input on first attempt. patternSourceLength counts chars inside #"..." so #"(.)\1" (chars: (,.,),\,1) = length 5 = par for HOLE 1.
